newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LEKS ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED 18 TIMES. [CORRECTED 19:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: LEKS ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED 18 TIMES. [CORRECTED 19:40 GMT]

text.p: A share issue by Leks Insurance was oversubsribed by 18 times, co-arranger (corrects from lead manager) Talinvest said on Tuesday.
Leks issued 190,000 new shares and investors subscribed over 3.4 million shares, Rain Nuka, project leader with Talinvest told Reuters.
The sale price of a 10-kroon face value share was 38 kroons.
Leks has increased its capital by four million kroons to 42 million kroons after the issue.
It has issued 1.9 million kroons of shares to the public and 2.1 million kroons to major shareholder Tallinna Pank .
Tallinna Pank (corrects from Talinvest) will also organize a listing of Leks shares on the Tallinn stock exchange.
